reviews.title: Made me fall in love with fitness again
reviews.text: Form has it all. The strength workouts get your cardio in seamlessly and are challenging and over in what feels like an instant. The platform is gorgeous and well thought out. Barre and Pilates style mat work are also available. There’s weekly schedules for both strength/ Pilates and a combination. Tons of programs to choose from for 2 week to one month programming. I would say 10/10 for quality and 20/10 for aesthetic. The thing that absolutely sets form apart outside of all of the above is the music. No one else has mashups like this. Everything from 80s to alternative to hip hop. You can’t not be motivated. The instructors are amazing and one Sammy S is proof the programming and mindset work. She’s done the transformation work herself to lose substantial weight and keep it off. These girls are passionate about their business and it shows. You can’t go wrong. And don’t be fooled you can do the OG strength workout circuits at the gym and just listen and have the best music going or they offer gym programming as well. Value is 10/10.

reviews.title: Just a few feedback to make it even better
reviews.text:
This has truly been the fitness app I’ve stayed to longest and most consistent with. 

There’s a few User Interface feedback that I think could really set FORM apart. 

1. Allow users to Pin their favorite sections for easier and faster selection. For example I consistently over the weeks use the weekly Gym workouts under WEEKLY SCHEDULES. however it’s the 5th row and last option to scroll down and over to. 

2. Allowing reorganization within sections and workouts. 
For example, I’m not pregnant right now. So the new Prenatal Gym Program is not applicable to me. I’m looking forward to using it in the future but don’t need it now. It would be nice to either hide the section or be able to reorder the sections to what I actually use. 

3. Weekly Gym schedules are sometimes not updated. I’ve noticed on 2 occasions the IG account will say that the weekly workouts are updated and they actually aren’t. Would be nice for those to be more align by either giving users an expected time that they will be updated or having internal teams have more eyes on what’s been updated to avoid confusion and being mislead that it’s updated. 

4. In the weekly gym schedules, the text on the video should be updated. The text in the top left corner that shows you the exercise, and the amount of corrupts is currently covered by the X to exit out of the video. I think putting this in the bottom left a right corner. Could easily fix that. As well as adding bullet points for the beginner, intermediate and advanced modifications. It takes more time to shift through the paragraph when you’re in a workout.

5. Also, in the weekly gym schedules, for each individual day, it would be nice to have more filter options to organize or reorder the exercises. Right now we’re limited to default, date released, and also about it. It would be nice to order how we prefer.

6. The slideshow section on the very top. That’s always updated is really cute but it takes up a lot of space. It would be nice to make it very smaller. So we can see more sections.

And more than happy to be beta tester and connect personally about some of these and how they can positively affect the users. Thanks so much!
